note: Design skeleton only. Every field marked PENDING_APPROVAL is an entry-gate decision (FULL_CAMPAIGN_ENTRY_GATE.md) and is NOT frozen. No numeric threshold here is a design constant.

frozen_core.window_rule: w_j = min(m_j, tau_j), truncated denominator, terminal increment included
frozen_core.stopping_rule: tau = inf{t>=1 : alarm after the update at step t}, two-sided, inclusive, no truncation, no minimum dwell

cells.m_exploratory_note: outside P3's boundary table; no rho_c annotation may be extrapolated to it
cells.rho_grid_note: must resolve [0.10, 0.35]: the measured in-control ARL optimum lies there (ledger S12, E2)

regimes.note: e0=null draws e_0 ~ N(0,1/m0) so the history channel is legally observable; e0=0.0 is the P7 finite-cycle convention and the history channel is withheld (OBSERVABILITY_AUDIT.md 4a).

metrics.gate_layer_rule: a closure gate may only reference an 'observable' or 'cost' metric

c_beta.status: PENDING - re-derive from p7_statistical_consequences/results/response_curves.json with an interpolation error budget

cost_model.note: H5 - a P6 modelling decision with no precedent in P5/P7; it changes every efficiency number

seeds.rule: TUNE fits, EVAL reports, REPLAY adjudicates; reuse across families invalidates the campaign

P3_confirm.n_rep: PENDING - set by the tail-event rule

numeric.G-A_tail: PENDING_APPROVAL (options A1/A2/A3; recommendation A1 with A3 declared fallback)
numeric.G-C_cost: PENDING_APPROVAL (options C-i/C-ii/C-iii; recommendation C-i gate + C-iii report)
numeric.G-D_breadth: PENDING_APPROVAL (options D1/D2/D3; recommendation D1, m=1 reported separately)
numeric.G-E_finite_cycle: DEFERRED TO POST-PILOT BY PRIOR AGREEMENT

forbidden: rho < rho_c as a controller, constraint or gate (X1)
suppressing the period-2 orbit as an objective (X2)
any P5 numeric as a design constant or threshold (X9)
latent e in any implementable policy (X11)
